label: Diagram 3.1
caption: Diagram 3.1 | Type A, plan view showing minimum dimensions
description: This is a plan view, titled "Diagram 3.1 Type A, plan view showing minimum dimensions", depicting a single disabled WC cubicle with a door on the right. A dark green rectangle, "Activity space WC", lies to the right of the toilet and a paler green rectangle, "Activity space washbasin", over the basin; a dashed circle, "465mm Ø", lies within the dark green rectangle, also to the right of the toilet. Along the top wall, left to right, the labels read Shelf, Space for disposal bin, Horizontal grab rail, Vertical grab rail, "2125mm minimum", High hook and low hook, Activity space, with dimensions 540mm, 100mm, 400mm and 100mm. The left wall shows 210mm and "985mm minimum". Around the toilet and its activity space are the dimensions 400mm, 200mm and 600mm, while 60mm at the bottom left gives the projection of the horizontal grab rail from the left wall; the basin shows 250mm, and the label HD on the rear wall above it denotes the hand-drying facility. Bottom labels are Horizontal grab rail, Vertical grab rail, Column of clearance and Horizontal closing bar. The door, with a dashed swing arc, is dimensioned 500mm, 60mm and 750mm. A legend and four NOTES appear below; the legend identifies the dark green as Activity space WC, the pale green as Activity space washbasin and HD as the Hand-drying facility.
